customManagers.description: Action versions the CI generator emits. V.scala is the source of truth for the generated workflows, so bumping a pin here is what actually changes CI.

packageRules.description: ci.yml, auto-approve.yml and auto-merge.yml are generated by zio-sbt-ci from V.scala. Editing them directly desynchronises the two and fails `sbt ciCheckGithubWorkflow` - which is how #694 left main broken.
A pin bumped in V.scala leaves the committed workflows stale until `sbt ciGenerateGithubWorkflow` is run, so these need a follow-up commit before they can merge.
